Cecil is a girl's name.

How could my Dad go out with Selma? Don't those two gargoyles know that love is for good-looking young people?

dialogue.text: Well, I got these free tickets to Santa's Village. I know a guy who turns the dead sleigh-horses into jerky and sells it to bars...

dialogue.text: Well, I gotta hand it to you, Homer. You're really brave to go through with this operation.

dialogue.text: Well, can I at least give her this Moe-bile?
